serviceAreas.localNote: Cincinnati levies a 1.8% net profit tax on business activity inside city limits, with the annual return due 15 April.
Cleveland’s 2.50% municipal income tax is collected by the Central Collection Agency (CCA), separately from the Ohio Department of Taxation.
Chicago’s Personal Property Lease Transaction Tax rose to 15% on 1 January 2026 and covers non-possessory computer leases, which includes cloud software.
Texas has no personal state income tax; the franchise tax no-tax-due threshold is $2,650,000 for 2026-2027 and reports are due 15 May.
California LLCs owe an $800 annual tax from year one, and the City of San Diego requires its own Business Tax Certificate.
North Carolina’s corporate income tax is a flat 2.00%; the franchise tax minimum is $200. Raleigh’s combined sales tax rate is 7.25%.
Mecklenburg County’s combined sales tax rate rose to 8.25% effective 1 July 2026 — a full point above Raleigh.
